purpose: Canonical geometry, layer, routing, and verification information for Qumus ReSe2 / 2D dual-gate bottom-contact transistor designs.

external_device_references.alignment_marker_read_policy: Read layer 1/0 recursively from every top cell in alignmarker2.GDS; do not assume a single top cell or call Layout.top_cell() on the template.

effective_device_layers.meaning: source/drain fingers, contact fan-out, graphite pickup landing and lead
four local split bottom gates and bottom-gate fan-out
shared outer routing for all nets and bond-pad landing necks

source_drain_array.placement: one opposing pair in each inter-gate gap plus one outer-edge pair beyond each end gate

routing.inner_zone_definition: fixed layout-coordinate rectangle for this ReSe2 profile; use the exact bbox and corners below

outer_electrode_width_policy.clearance_priority: widen only where it does not create same-layer different-net contact, overlap, or route-to-route clearance violations

verification_checks: imported alignmarker2 geometry is present on layer 1/0
read alignmarker2.GDS layer 1/0 recursively from all template top cells; current template has 33 top cells and 80 merged layer-1/0 polygons
21 imported nominal-250 um pad-like landing regions are reused when alignmarker2.GDS is available; otherwise fallback 250 um x 250 um square bond pads are generated
four bottom gates use the canonical widths unless overridden
five source/drain pairs are present unless overridden
500 nm blank lateral gaps are maintained between neighboring metal strips
source/drain and bottom-gate straight segments overhang ReSe2 vertically by at least 2 um
left graphite pickup landing is exposed and not blocked by top hBN
outer electrode/routing segments beyond the fixed inner-zone boundary are wider than central active-region fingers/gates and still satisfy different-net clearance checks
new metal does not unintentionally overlap imported markers or pads outside intended landing necks
same-layer geometry is merged before save/verification
